expression.zh: 在浦东机场搭乘市域机场线，应寻找“浦东1号2号航站楼站”。

conditions: PVG T1/T2 passengers; confirm current airport signs
excludedInferences: No travel-time, first/last-train, fare or missed-flight guarantee

expression.zh: 上海地铁站服务中心设有银行卡购票终端；可受理官网列明的境外卡种。
expression.en: Shanghai metro service centres offer card terminals for buying tickets with the overseas networks listed in the official guide.

conditions: Use the staffed service-centre purchase channel; card/issuer approval still applies
excludedInferences: Not a promise that every foreign card taps directly through gates
No bus-wide acceptance inference

expression.zh: 上海博物馆东馆普通散客入馆目前免预约；部分互动展区、特展和团队另有安排。
expression.en: Ordinary individual entry at Shanghai Museum East currently needs no reservation; specified experiences, exhibitions and groups have separate rules.

conditions: East branch only; original valid identification and security screening
Curio-City and Digital Gallery still require special reservations
excludedInferences: Not the People’s Square branch rule
No guaranteed capacity or free access to every exhibition

expression.zh: 首都机场T3的网约车候车点为3号停车楼B2层H区；以现场和订单提示复核。

conditions: PEK T3 only; an actual booking is still required
excludedInferences: Not T2 or Daxing
No fare or car-arrival guarantee

conditions: Physical contactless JCB card; operator/card conditions and present signage apply
excludedInferences: No2026 station-count guarantee
